```sql
SELECT g.poi_name, ST_Distance(g.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois g
WHERE g.poi_name ILIKE '%gallery%'
  AND ST_DWithin(g.geometry::geography, (
    SELECT p.geometry
    FROM pois p
    WHERE p.poi_name ILIKE '%pine grove zoo%'
      AND p.addr_city ILIKE '%little falls%'
      AND p.addr_state ILIKE '%mn%'
    LIMIT 1
  ), 10000)
ORDER BY g.geometry <-> (
  SELECT p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  WHERE p.poi_name ILIKE '%pine grove zoo%'
    AND p.addr_city ILIKE '%little falls%'
    AND p.addr_state ILIKE '%mn%'
  LIMIT 1
)
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT t1.poi_name, t1.wikidata, t1.wikipedia,
       ST_Distance(t1.geometry::geography, t2.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois t1,
     (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%City Suites Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Chicago%' LIMIT 1) t2
WHERE t1.tourism = 'gallery'
  AND ST_DWithin(t1.geometry::geography, t2.geometry::geography, 10000)
ORDER BY t1.geometry <-> t2.geometry
LIMIT 1;
```

                 (SELECT ST_Centroid(r.geometry) FROM roads r WHERE r.road_name ILIKE '%Mountain Bike Trail%' LIMIT 1)::geography,
